measurement_note: Size S is the number of nodes. Legal tiers 63, 255, and 511 span more than 8x. Each tree has a chain of (S+1)/2 nodes ending in a hub with the remaining leaves; exactly one leaf has cost 2 and every other cost is 1, so the answer is the number of lower-cost leaves. The accepted iterative postorder visits Theta(S) nodes and edges. A correct calibrated alternative recomputes every node's subtree maximum with a fresh traversal, taking Theta(S^2) on the long shared chain; it must pass every output and fail only the scaling verdict.
